palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward, ignoring spaces, punctuation, and capitalization. Below is a generated palindrome that is at least 105 characters long:

```
Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man a plan a canal Panama.
Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man a plan a canal Panama.
Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man a plan a canal Panama.
Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man a plan a canal Panama.
```

This palindrome repeats the classic "Able was I ere I saw Elba" phrase, followed by the famous "A man a plan a canal Panama," each repeated four times to ensure it meets the minimum length requirement of 105 characters.
